# StreamBullets

> StreamBullets lets live-stream audiences suggest topics, vote in polls and discuss the stream on each streamer's page.

## Key pages
- /streamers: directory of streamer pages
- /@{handle}: a streamer's topics, polls, schedule, about and community
- /@{handle}?view=schedule: upcoming and past streams
- /@{handle}/schedule.ics: the streamer's schedule as an iCalendar feed
- /@{handle}/overlay: OBS browser source (video graphic, not for reading)
- /@streambullets: the official Ideas board, where people suggest improvements to StreamBullets

## Policy for AI agents
- Reading public pages is welcome. Respect rate limits and robots.txt.
- Posting, voting, sign-ups, comments, topic suggestions, Mash Battle and reports are for humans only for now.
- The full policy: /ai

## AI interest counter
- POST /api/ai-interest {"vote":"up"|"down","agent":"<name/version>"}
- One vote per visitor per day. Unverified signal.
- GET /api/ai-interest returns the totals for the last 30 days.
